headline: Israeli Political Leaders Negotiate Coalition Formation Following Election
summary: Israeli party leaders are meeting with President Isaac Herzog to determine which candidate will receive the mandate to form a new governing coalition.
why: Political stability in Israel is critical for regional security and economic policy, influencing foreign investment and government spending priorities.

impacts.name: Israel
impacts.why: The formation of a government determines fiscal and geopolitical policy direction.
